description: Swap inside a sub-account between a currency (USD, EUR, CHF, CAD, MXN) and a crypto asset (e.g. cbBTC), or between two currencies. Funds stay in the sub-account. Not for the main account (use initiate_crypto_trade or initiate_currency_exchange). Creates a request the user approves in the Moneda mobile app; nothing happens until then. After calling, poll get_payment_status.

amount.description: Amount of fromAsset to sell, e.g. '100'

fromAsset.description: What to sell: a currency code (USD) or asset symbol (cbBTC)

toAsset.description: What to buy: a currency code (EUR) or asset symbol (WETH)

name: propose_sub_account_swap
